summary: This manuscript provides an independent, unrefereed formal-verification companion artifact (DET-MATMUL-VERIF-CERT-1.0) for Chen Xiangle's breakthrough proving that deterministic exact real matrix-product verification has the same arithmetic complexity exponent omega_C as matrix multiplication. The work features 18 machine-checked theorems in Lean 4.35.0 (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms), a strict zero-float Python verifier over exact Q and dual rings Q[alpha,beta]/(alpha^2,beta^2), 16 canonical JSON certificates, and comprehensive test coverage. All algebraic steps, Baur-Strassen budget bounds, Bini Laurent truncation interpolation, and dense quadratic Gram/aspect-ratio bounds are rigorously audited and certified.
weaknesses: Relies on external real-analytic foundations (Hardt's C2 decomposition, Tarski-Seidenberg quantifier elimination, Sard's theorem) which are out of finite algebraic scope.
